teaser: The tape gun stutters as you seal the last box, and somewhere among the boxes is the one thing you promised to drop off at the shelter on the way. That's the shape of a 9 who is also an ESTP: a life path built around letting go, carried by a type that moves by instinct and impact. You feel other people's weight before you feel your own, and you handle it the way you handle everything else — fast, physical, already halfway out the door with it.
excerpt: A boarding pass crumples in your fist while you walk a stranger through security instead of checking your own gate, the departure board blinking a time you've stopped watching.
